explication: OpenCreator is a local AI workspace for creator tools and Codex-powered agent conversations. The main workflow is: a user works in the Web or Desktop client, the local daemon accepts API requests, then either runs a creator job through staged media/content executors or submits an agent run to Codex. Results, events, files, and state are persisted locally and streamed back to the client. The graph emphasizes documented capabilities; several feature routes are represented by their exact paths, while unsampled internal calls are intentionally omitted.
